research_mode: official MHCLG, ONS and Police.uk web sources only; corrected IoD25 files, relative-rank semantics, 2021 LSOA geography, anonymised police locations and unmapped-crime guards; no parcel result or safety probability claimed

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: English indices of deprivation 2025 official statistics package
verified_claims: published 30 October 2025 and last updated 17 November 2025
Files 1 to 9 were corrected and users are instructed to use updated v2 workbooks
the package includes domain ranks, scores, deciles, denominators, underlying indicators and transformed domain scores
limitations: only corrected v2 artifacts are acceptable for runtime joins
a package landing page does not itself bind a parcel to an LSOA

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: English indices of deprivation 2025 statistical release
verified_claims: IoD25 uses 33,755 Census 2021 LSOAs in England
Crime is one of seven domains and measures risk of personal and material victimisation at local level
IoD ranks are relative and a rank of 100 is not twice as deprived as rank 200
limitations: Crime Domain rank is not a probability of crime or a cardinal safety score
IoD25 cannot quantify absolute deprivation or identify individual people

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: English indices of deprivation 2025 frequently asked questions
verified_claims: the FAQ describes joining the ONS postcode lookup to IoD25 using the LSOA column
LSOAs rank from 1 most deprived to 33,755 least deprived
ranks and deciles are the recommended interpretation for most IoD and domain uses
limitations: postcode best-fit lookup is not a substitute for exact point-in-polygon parcel assignment
Crime Domain scores must not be interpreted as population proportions

sources.name: Statistical geographies: Lower layer Super Output Areas
verified_claims: 2021 LSOAs are built from Output Areas and some 2011 LSOAs were split or merged
England has 33,755 LSOAs and Wales has 1,917
official 2021 boundary sets, names, codes and lookup files are supplied through the ONS Open Geography portal
limitations: 2011 and 2021 LSOA codes or boundaries must not be silently mixed
generalised boundaries require explicit edition and geometry-precision recording

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: data.police.uk provenance and CSV field documentation
verified_claims: police forces provide monthly Crime and ASB and outcome files which undergo quality assurance
published LSOA code and name refer to the LSOA containing the anonymised point
published longitude and latitude are anonymised coordinates
limitations: the published LSOA belongs to an anonymised snap point rather than the exact incident address
monthly administrative extracts remain subject to later correction or reclassification

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: data.police.uk location anonymisation and known quality issues
verified_claims: published crime coordinates always represent approximate rather than exact locations
exact locations are replaced by privacy-protecting map points with at least eight addresses or none
the site reports force geocoding accuracy estimates ranging from 60 to 97 percent and describes monthly data as mutable snapshots
limitations: an anonymised crime point must not be treated as an exact parcel event
source-level quality assurance does not justify 95 percent confidence for parcel attribution

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Street-level crimes API contract
verified_claims: the endpoint supports a one-mile point query or custom polygon and an optional YYYY-MM month
returned locations are approximations rather than exact crime locations
custom areas containing more than 10,000 crimes return HTTP 503
limitations: a one-mile response is not a parcel observation
503 or oversized responses require bounded subdivision rather than silent omission

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Crimes with no location API contract
verified_claims: the endpoint returns crimes that could not be mapped to a location
these records have null location and location_type fields
records retain month, category, persistent identifier and available outcome status
limitations: unmapped crimes cannot be spatially assigned to a parcel or LSOA
excluding them from spatial counts must be explicitly disclosed as a completeness limitation
